caption: The drawing depicts a technical architectural sketch of a wooden bench or pew, displayed primarily from the front and side view. The composition is made on a light beige or off-white background, with precise, straight black pencil or ink lines. The main object is a rectangular bench with six recessed rectangular panels across its front, each bordered with beveled edges. The horizontal top rail of the bench is straight, and the vertical legs at the edges are prominent, extending below the panel section. Measurement annotations are included: the width of the bench is 5 feet 2 inches, the height to the top rail is 3 feet 1 inch, and the thickness of the side leg in the side profile is 1½ inches. The rectangular panels are each marked with dimensions, with the first panel on the left measured at 8½ inches wide and the remaining panels at 9½ inches wide each. On the right side of the drawing is a side elevation of the bench, showing the profile of an armrest with a gentle curve, a straight back-rest, and a flat, horizontal seat. The name "H. Eisman" appears in the lower right-hand corner of the page, indicating the possible author or draftsman of the drawing.
title: Settee
